installSteps.iphone: Open the site in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add.
installSteps.android: Open the site in Chrome. From the menu, choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
installSteps.windows: Open the site in Chrome or Edge and choose Install app from the address bar or browser menu.
installSteps.mac: Open the site in Chrome or Edge and choose Install app, or choose File → Add to Dock in Safari.

video.limits: MP4 up to128 MiB and30 minutes. Local processing time depends on video length.
video.useZone: Use an area within the image
video.zoneHelp: Define the bay region after rotation. Values are image percentages: origin,width,height. Tracking uses the vehicle center.
video.error: Request failed. Check the file, branch and observation area, then retry.
video.failed: Analysis failed. Check the file, worker and model installation.
video.warning: Bay presence does not prove a completed wash. Fine vehicle category and wash service require review. Missing detection is not an exit. One vehicle may produce several track fragments; track count is not vehicle count.
video.partial: Observation incomplete at one or both ends
video.samplingSlow: One frame every2 seconds — stationary bay footage
video.recordingHint: Leave blank if uncertain. Screen recording or accelerated playback can invalidate timing.
video.drawZone: Drag on the frame to select the bay, or use the values below.
video.showOutside: Also show observations outside the bay
video.occupancyHelp: Relative to video start. Bay occupancy is separate from active washing or spraying time.
video.gateSetup: Calibrate the bay entrance for automation
video.enableGate: Detect entrance and exit gate crossings
video.gateHelp: Select the bay after correcting orientation. Blue confirms entry; pink marks exit. Values are percentages from image top. Entry must be below exit. Calibration belongs to this camera viewpoint.
video.gateSaved: Calibration saved and reused for this camera.
video.rawTrackHelp: These are individual track fragments. Bay entrance and exit events are shown above.
